title: BuildersTNT
description: this projects replaces normal TNT with special ones which makes the destruction into unique builds.
body:
When TNT explodes, it builds structures instead of destroying. No explosion damage, just cool builds(e.g fancy walls, Towers, Rooms and much more) all Survival Friendly and moreover require different colour conrete and a tnt on top for it to work!
Place TNT on colored concrete:
Red = Castle
Blue = Tower
White = Wall
Orange = Fortress
Light it up with flint & steel or arrows
